records.source: Drop items here to ship them for sale.
records.translation: Ihulog dito ang mga bagay upang ipadala at ibenta.
Paganahin ang mga pahiwatig sa tutorial?

records.source: First, choose your appearance and farm type. When you're done, tap the check mark button to start playing.
records.translation: Una, piliin ang iyong anyo at uri ng bukid. Kapag tapos ka na, i-tap ang button na may tsek upang magsimulang maglaro.

records.source: Good morning! Remember to head back to the farmhouse to sleep and save your game later on.
records.translation: Magandang umaga! Tandaang bumalik sa Bahay-Bukid mamaya upang matulog at i-save ang laro.

records.source: You've received a gift! Tap on the package to open it.
records.translation: Nakatanggap ka ng regalo! I-tap ang pakete upang buksan ito.

records.source: New quests are shown in the Journal. Tap on a quest to take a closer look - there's useful information there!
records.translation: Lumalabas sa Talaan ang mga bagong misyon. I-tap ang isang misyon upang tingnan itong mabuti—may kapaki-pakinabang na impormasyon roon!

records.source: Tap the Close button when you're done with the Journal.
records.translation: I-tap ang button na Isara kapag tapos ka na sa Talaan.

records.source: Looks like quite a mess! Let's clear this place up.
records.translation: Napakagulo rito! Linisin natin ang lugar.

records.source: Tap on a weed to clear it.
records.translation: I-tap ang damo upang alisin ito.

records.source: Well done! Try clearing some more weeds and rocks.
records.translation: Magaling! Subukang mag-alis pa ng mga damo at bato.

records.source: You can use the hoe to prepare the soil for planting.
records.translation: Magagamit mo ang Asarol upang ihanda ang lupa para sa pagtatanim.

records.source: Try preparing a garden patch to sow your first seeds.
records.translation: Subukang maghanda ng taniman para sa una mong mga binhi.

records.source: Great work... time to add some seeds.
records.translation: Mahusay... oras na upang maglagay ng mga binhi.

records.source: They look thirsty - there's a watering can in the toolbar.
records.translation: Mukhang nauuhaw sila—may Pandilig sa toolbar.

records.source: Well done! Remember to water your crops every day.
records.translation: Magaling! Tandaang diligan ang iyong mga pananim araw-araw.

records.source: Once you've finished watering, feel free to explore Pelican Town and meet your new neighbors!
records.translation: Kapag tapos ka nang magdilig, malaya mong galugarin ang Bayan ng Pelican at kilalanin ang bago mong mga kapitbahay!

records.source: You can fill your watering can at a pond or river.
records.translation: Mapupuno mo ang Pandilig sa isang munting lawa o ilog.

records.source: Tap and hold to walk toward your finger.
records.translation: I-tap at panatilihing nakadiin upang maglakad patungo sa iyong daliri.

records.source: Hold and drag to follow your finger around.
records.translation: Panatilihing nakadiin at i-drag upang sundan ang galaw ng iyong daliri.

records.source: Let's take a look at some other game functions.
records.translation: Tingnan natin ang iba pang kakayahan ng laro.

records.source: The Inventory shows the items you're holding. You can drag them to rearrange, or to the trash to destroy them.
records.translation: Ipinakikita ng Imbentaryo ang mga bagay na dala mo. Maaari mong i-drag ang mga ito upang ayusin, o dalhin sa basura upang sirain.

records.source: This page shows your skills - you can improve your skills by using tools, foraging, fishing and fighting.
records.translation: Ipinakikita ng pahinang ito ang iyong mga kasanayan—mapahuhusay mo ang mga ito sa paggamit ng kasangkapan, pangangalap, pangingisda, at pakikipaglaban.

records.source: The Social page tells you about your relationships with the people you meet.
records.translation: Ipinakikita ng pahina ng Pakikisalamuha ang ugnayan mo sa mga taong nakikilala mo.

records.source: This is where you can craft new items from the things you collect and grow. You will discover new crafting recipes throughout the game.
records.translation: Dito ka makalilikha ng mga bagong bagay mula sa iyong kinokolekta at itinatanim. Makatutuklas ka ng mga bagong resipe sa paglikha habang naglalaro.

records.source: Slide your finger over the map to explore Pelican Town and its surroundings.
records.translation: I-slide ang iyong daliri sa mapa upang galugarin ang Bayan ng Pelican at ang paligid nito.

records.source: The Collections page keeps track of what you've shipped, fished, mined, cooked or discovered.
records.translation: Itinatala ng pahina ng Mga Koleksiyon ang iyong mga ipinadala, nahuling isda, namina, niluto, at natuklasan.

records.source: In stores, tap on the counter in front of the shopkeeper to buy or sell goods.
records.translation: Sa mga tindahan, i-tap ang puwesto sa harap ng tindero upang bumili o magbenta ng paninda.

records.source: We need some seeds to plant... did you miss something back in the farmhouse?
records.translation: Kailangan natin ng mga binhing itatanim... may naiwan ka ba sa Bahay-Bukid?

records.source: Are you sure you want to exit and lose any progress since the start of this game day?
records.translation: Sigurado ka bang gusto mong lumabas at mawala ang lahat ng pagsulong mula nang magsimula ang araw na ito sa laro?
Gabay sa Paglalagay ng Bagay

records.source: You can choose between auto and manual attack modes on the game options screen.
records.translation: Maaari kang pumili sa awtomatiko at manwal na mode ng pag-atake sa screen ng mga opsiyon sa laro.

records.source: Would you like to restore from where you previously left off?
records.translation: Gusto mo bang ibalik ang laro sa dati mong iniwan?

records.source:
Stardew Valley needs to perform a one time copy of your farms to a new location for the 1.5 update of the game.

In the following screen please select the `StardewValley` folder and tap 'Use this folder'.
records.translation:
Kailangang minsanang kopyahin ng Stardew Valley ang iyong mga bukid sa bagong lokasyon para sa update 1.5 ng laro.

Sa susunod na screen, piliin ang folder na `StardewValley` at i-tap ang 'Gamitin ang folder na ito'.
